lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 2 tests, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder, finish redesign, and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

candidates.title: Path Selection Interactive Persona Cards
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen with an interactive card layout highlighting pet traits and playstyles.
candidates.why: 23.8% drop off at path selection, with a very high mean duration of 514s indicating user decision paralysis.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path screen allowed under onboarding customization rules.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has high duration, but full screen redesigns carry execution risk.

candidates.title: Pet Selection Direct Gallery Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a fast-track gallery flow on pick_friend allowing immediate avatar selection without complex configuration.
candidates.why: Adoption drop off is 28.3% with a long mean duration of 1017s, showing friction during pet setup.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of pick_friend screen preserving pet selection capability.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has 28.3% drop off; new_flow history is mixed but slightly positive (+1.9%).

candidates.title: Account Auto-Save Security Note
candidates.change: Display an explicit helper hint on sign-in clarifying that account sign-in locks pet progress safely to the cloud.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion and syncs data safely across sessions.

guard.reason: Adding a security hint to sign_in is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in changes consistently perform well and 8 support emails show direct user friction.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate First Customization Reorder
candidates.change: Move the adoption certificate stage to come immediately after companion selection and before photo uploads.
candidates.why: Adoption drops off 28.3%; naming the pet early builds emotional connection before demanding photo uploads.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Verification New Screen
candidates.change: Add a final onboarding verification screen to test and confirm pet visibility on the desktop background.
candidates.why: Finish step has a high drop-off rate (35.2%), and support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on desktop.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Verify Companion on Desktop
new_desktop_verify.body: Make sure your companion is visible on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen after home_intro is allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens to finish step consistently degraded performance in past tests (-4.0%).

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Live Activity Feed
candidates.change: Add dynamic activity updates and asset rendering progress info to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes mean 2336s with an 18.7% drop rate during pet generation.

guard.reason: Adding dynamic progress info to the waiting screen during a real wait is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is 18.7% with long wait time; activity feed helps set expectations.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Reassurance Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update headline copy on photo upload screen assuring users that default pets are generated if photos fail.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photo or Use Default Companion Avatar
upload_photos.body: If photo upload isn't perfect, we will auto-generate a fallback avatar so your companion looks great.

guard.reason: Copy update on upload_photos screen is valid and does not violate copy rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy reassurance addresses direct support complaints during adoption.

candidates.title: Background Pet Render System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notifications when pet generation completes while the app is minimized.
candidates.why: Mean time on waiting stage is 2336s, indicating users leave the window idle during processing.

guard.reason: Enabling desktop notifications on waiting screen is allowed under onboarding timing/notification rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high background idle time (2336s mean) with minimal engineering overhead.

candidates.title: Home Intro Controls Overview Layout
candidates.change: Re-layout home intro into a split screen showcasing primary controls and system tray interactions.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Pet & Learn Quick Controls

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout is allowed within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage redesigns/layout changes historically underperform (-7.7%).

candidates.title: Story Screen Path Selector Motivation Badge
candidates.change: Add a highlight badge on the story screen introducing path selection benefits and unlockable companion traits.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an 8s median / 514s mean time.

guard.reason: Adding a informational highlight badge to the story screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost badge addition targeting decision hesitation at choose_path.
